title: Samaṇabrāhmaṇa
text: 2. Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni pañca || || Sukhindriyaṃ || pe || upekhindriyaṃ || || 3. Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā imesaṃ pañcannam indriyānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca- -yathābhūtam nappajānanti- na ca panete- -viharanti || || 4. Ye hi keci- -pajjānanti || te kho- -sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti || ||
